ctx.x: All right, okay. One question was, you know, you read in all the jazz books and you hear people talking about the New Orleans style and so then we heard all of the traditional stuff in Europe, the Trad stuff as they call it and the revival stuff, mostly by white bands, who studied the old recordings and so on, and I wonder if they helped people know what the New Orleans music was or they got in the way of it. For example, Clancy Hayes and the banjo and all that singing, you know, Turk, and all that stuff or was
Well, Clancy got all that stuff, you know, from the records, you know, of Kid Ory, King Oliver, those bands, you understand. And they passed it around, you understand?
